display.purpose: Hero and act titles. Bodoni Moda 600, sentence case.

narrative.overview: A celadon blotter under north light. Pharmacy ink, brass CTAs darkened from the yellow capsules, Bodoni masthead. The visitor reads a 90-day skeptic review and hops to official stores — pills or the Haircare Set.

rules.name: The Brass CTA Rule
rules.body: Primary actions fill accentDark, not the yellow pill. Hover may warm to ochre with ink text.

rules.name: The No HUD Rule
rules.body: No uppercase display, no neon glow, no Sora, no Bricolage, no glass caustics.

rules.name: The Dual Hop Rule
rules.body: Two official URLs. Quiz emphasizes; it never hides a SKU or a legal page.
